scores: 2x2 table of forecast >= threshold vs observed >= threshold per station-day: POD, FAR, CSI, Peirce skill score PSS = POD - POFD
pass_rule_categorical: PASS for a group and lead only when: observed events >= 20, POD >= 0.5, FAR <= 0.5 and the 95 % lower bound of PSS > 0. Fewer than 20 events = INCONCLUSIVE (stays withheld). A level is released only where every lead it is served at passes

C6.what: wind gust Beaufort classes by exposure, and the 31 mountain tehsils
C6.observed: daily maximum of the hourly gust maximum, station-days with >= 20 of 24 hours
C6.threshold_source: Beaufort scale onsets (WMO-No. 8 / WMO Manual on Codes): gale force 8 from 62 km/h, storm force 10 from 89 km/h
C6.release_if_pass: the Beaufort gale (and storm) class on the forecast gust, for that exposure group, labelled 'Beaufort class, not a damage level'
C6.ensemble_chance_mountains: the ensemble chance of a client limit in the mountains needs the archived ensemble at leads 1-3: the archive starts 29 Oct 2026; tested when it holds >= 20 observed exceedance days in the mountain group

C7.what: rain triggers: 3-day total >= 75 mm (rain3_75) and the day amounts 10/25/50/100 mm (pr10..pr100) on held-out data, with client consequences
C7.forecast: 3-day total = sum of the 3 forecast PKT days at leads 1-3 (day 1 at lead 1, day 2 at lead 2, day 3 at lead 3); day amount = the PKT-day sum at the lead
C7.threshold_source: the thresholds of the withheld events themselves (outlook.mjs EVENTS_ALL / THRESHOLDS_ALL)
C7.consequences: per station and year: false alarms and misses a client with that trigger would have had (counts per 365 days)
C7.chance_limits: the served day events are ENSEMBLE chances; their reliability needs the archived ensemble (from 29 Oct 2026): INCONCLUSIVE until it holds >= 20 observed events per threshold; the deterministic categorical test above is reported as the evidence on the model's amounts

C8.what: heavy rain in the coast and hills groups (the untested tehsils)
C8.threshold_source: IMD 24-h rain category 'heavy' onset 15.6 mm (the tested product's own threshold, hazard-scale.json)
C8.release_if_pass: the heavy-rain level is served in that group's tehsils with the method of the tested tehsils (instead of 'not tested')

C9.what: area heat/cold summary rule (a tehsil's level = the level reached over >= 25 % of its area) and heat exposure duration / activity
C9.test: the rule is a summary convention; a test needs an outcome per tehsil-day (heat illness, hospital or mortality records, or worker exposure logs) or >= 3 truth stations inside one tehsil to compare the 25 % rule with the observed spread
C9.pass_rule: PASS only if, on tehsil-days with >= 3 truth stations, the level served by the 25 % rule equals the level reached by >= 25 % of the stations on >= 80 % of days (95 % lower bound >= 0.7); otherwise INCONCLUSIVE when fewer than 30 such tehsil-days with any heat level >= Moderate exist

C10.test: daily mean measured PM2.5 (EPA AQI 2024 classes) against the day's ventilation index (mixing height x mean wind) from the held archive; Spearman correlation and the PM2.5 distribution per band
C10.pass_rule: PASS only if: >= 200 station-days with both values, Spearman rho < 0 with 95 % upper bound < 0, the median PM2.5 falls monotonically from the poorest band to the best, and adjacent bands differ (Mann-Whitney, Holm-adjusted p < 0.05). A ventilation history at the stations' hours is required: if the archive holds none, INCONCLUSIVE with the data named
